query:
WITH RECURSIVE target_playlists AS (
                            SELECT id
                            FROM playlists
                            WHERE id = ANY($1)
                              AND deleted_at IS NULL
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT p.id
                            FROM playlists p
                            JOIN target_playlists tp ON p.parent_id = tp.id
                            WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
                        )
                        SELECT EXISTS(
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM target_playlists
                            WHERE id = $2
                        ) AS "exists!"
